802b3e54-3c53-4b37-a089-8e97a4e163f3@ufc.why: Heavyweight headliner has #5-ranked Waldo Cortes-Acosta, trying to snap a two-fight skid, facing Johnny Walker, who you saw score a knockout at UFC 332 five weeks ago. The co-main is a long-awaited rematch of sorts: #2 Tatiana Suarez vs #3 Virna Jandiroba, two former title challengers whose fight fell apart twice before, with the winner moving closer to a strawweight title shot.
802b3e54-3c53-4b37-a089-8e97a4e163f3@ufc.know: Rankings run from champion down to #15 in each division, so two top-5 matchups on one card is notable. Fight Night events are weekly, non-title shows where contenders build their case for a future title shot. A unanimous decision means all three judges agreed on the winner after the fight went the distance.
